text_block_list.text:
The "Arima Kinen." A special GⅠ where 
umamusume ranking high in the fan poll get 
priority entry, but...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san, I'm getting nervous~. My 
legs are shaking a little. But...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: âI'm off!

text_block_list.text:
At first, Kitasan Black didn't stand out 
much. Even so, she slowly began to draw 
more and more attention—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And here she is! Coming in 3rd place in 
this year's fan vote—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Kitasan Black!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you for your cheers, everyone! I 
look forward to working with you!"
(Clap, clap, clap!)

She has finally climbed all the way to 3rd 
place. Slowly but surely, recognition of 
her stellar running style is spreading.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And taking the glorious first place this 
year is—!
(Whooosh, whooosh...!)

text_block_list.name: Local Fisherman
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? What's that? Coming this way from 
out in the open water? Could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Local Fisherman
text_block_list.text: A-A ship! It's a golden ship!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Peace peace! We're grabbing snow crabs 
with our bare hands from the Golden 
Fishing Boat! Bow down to the great Gold 
Ship!
(WOOOOAAAH!)

Gold Ship made an entrance with a bizarre 
theatrical flair, sending the crowd into a 
roaring frenzy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Kitasan. Looks like you managed to 
find your way to this fishing ground after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because I had my eyes opened back 
then too. On that beach!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right, bring it on, bring it right to 
me! Back this summer, you were just a 
young yellowtail—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Let's see if you've grown into a 
full-fledged Yellowtail! First up, let's 
see those poses!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like this, see, like this! Can you do 
this?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Like this, right! We can't afford to mess 
up during the real deal, so let's give it 
everything we've got right now!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you today, 
Golshi-san!

Perform with cheer, compete with fire. 
This is the year-end festival. Kitasan 
Black takes on the "Unsinkable 
Battleship," Gold Ship!
